propositions: CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points must compose a single immutable OperationSnapshot containing validated non-secret effective values, explicit source-kind provenance, repository root, and envelope version before execution

Composition precedence is explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root selected as explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory

Shadow mode composition is enabled by default via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW and does not control execution; malformed config raises typed error before lock/network/write, other failures emit redacted warnings and allow authoritative operation to proceed unchanged

Snapshot fields exclude live auth objects, secret wrappers/values, provider clients, source-file paths, and subprocess environments; secret sentinels must be absent from serialization, fingerprint, repr, equality, hashing, and diagnostic boundaries

Given identical five-layer inputs, representative ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations through all entry points produce identical immutable snapshot values, source kinds, root, version, and fingerprint
Environment/file/cwd mutation after snapshot capture leaves current operation's serialized snapshot unchanged while a second operation observes new values
